content.short: NFThubs is a platform for any artist or creator to sell their work digitally. NFThubs promotes social projects.
content.description: We have created NFThubs because we saw a need for a platform where artists anywhere in the world can onboard to sell their art on the Cardano blockchain. There are many different categories, from painters to instagram influences. From photographers to 3D artists, and so on. Due to our unique payment solution called HydraPay we are able to organise the sales in such a way that part of the proceedings goes to social projects all over the world which we sponsor. These projects are the NFThubs and the intention is to make them independent and self sustainable.
content.meta: Find out about NFThubs (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
